A little help. A lot of heart.

A helping voice, when you choose.

Voice assistance is designed around push-to-talk with visible listening and a text alternative.

01

Check your device

Some Fire tablets do not have a suitable Android speech recognition service. Recognition and text-to-speech language support are separate.

02

Review before acting

A transcription and structured command preview help adults check what the device understood before making changes.

03

Children and speech

Child microphone input is disabled by default and needs parental activation plus review of any external speech processing. Offline core use does not guarantee offline voice recognition.
